{% autoescape off %}# Naren Ultrasound & Fetal Medicine Center

> Naren Ultrasound & Fetal Medicine Center is a diagnostic ultrasound and fetal medicine center in Maharanipeta, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India. The center provides antenatal and gynecological ultrasound, routine ultrasound, paediatric scans, Doppler studies, ultrasound-guided procedures, and small-parts imaging. Information on this website is educational and does not replace individualized medical advice.

## Center

- [Home]({{ origin }}{% url 'home' %}): Overview of the center, services, specialist and appointments.
- [About]({{ origin }}{% url 'about' %}): Background, care approach and center values.
- [Doctor]({{ origin }}{% url 'doctors' %}): Profile, qualifications and experience of Dr. Naren Satya, Consultant Radiologist and Fetal Medicine Specialist.
- [Gallery]({{ origin }}{% url 'gallery' %}): Images of the center and its service categories.
- [Patient Information]({{ origin }}{% url 'patient_info' %}): Patient-facing contact details, location and working hours.
- [Contact]({{ origin }}{% url 'contact' %}): Contact and appointment information.

## Ultrasound and Fetal Medicine Services

- [All Services]({{ origin }}{% url 'services' %}): Official directory of scans and procedures offered by the center.

### Service categories

- Antenatal & Gynecological Scans: TIFFA/anomaly scans, early and late TIFFA, NT scans, viability and dating scans, fetal echocardiography, growth assessment, obstetric Doppler, follicular studies and other listed examinations, including applicable twin-pregnancy variants.
- Routine Scans: Whole abdomen, pelvis, KUB and other listed abdominal and pelvic ultrasound examinations.
- Paediatric Scans: Paediatric abdomen, neurosonogram/USG cranium and neonatal spine scans.
- Doppler Scans: Listed carotid, renal, arterial and venous Doppler examinations.
- USG Guided Procedures: Listed ultrasound-guided procedures, including amniocentesis and fetal reduction; suitability must be determined by the treating clinician.
- USG Small Parts: Neck/thyroid, scrotal, chest, soft-tissue, joint and related listed examinations.
